slice: Recover short Decimal/DOUBLE IN execution performance using unique constant inverses
scope: Optional DataFusion 54.1.0 optimizer patch. At most three constants; Decimal128-to-Float64 CAST/TRY_CAST only. Native casts, simplification and execution remain in use.

provenance.source_note: Spark provides precedent for guarded cast unwrapping. This per-literal round-trip and adjacent-coefficient proof is a local change, not copied Sail code or an upstream fix.

packaging.note: The packaged patch uses upstream rustfmt settings. Production differences from the measured source are whitespace only; formatting also removes one trailing argument comma in a test call. Build and timing hashes identify the measured source. No runtime logic changed after measurements.

performance_method: One partition, CPU 2, 1048576 rows, batches of 8192; two warmups and nine samples. Medians of process medians. Four fresh processes per version/query/phase, balanced order; eight per version in the historical execution comparison. Separate FIFO-gated planning and execution counters. All builds and correctness checks finished before timing. The historical binary is used only for this validated finite-input benchmark; its general mixed-numeric semantics are incorrect.
